title: Intersection number as a multivariate Euler-characteristic coefficient
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $X$ be a proper scheme over $k$ [def-weil-proper-morphism], and let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] with $Z$ nonempty and $d=\dim Z$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Let $\mathcal L_1,\ldots,\mathcal L_d$ be invertible $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-sc-invertible-module]. The intersection number $(\mathcal L_1\cdots\mathcal L_d\cdot Z)$ is the coefficient of $n_1\cdots n_d$ in the numerical polynomial $(n_1,\ldots,n_d)\mapsto\chi(X,i_*\mathcal O_Z\otimes\mathcal L_1^{\otimes n_1}\otimes\cdots\otimes\mathcal L_d^{\otimes n_d})$ [def-pc-euler-characteristic]. That this function is a numerical polynomial of total degree at most $\dim\operatorname{Supp}(i_*\mathcal O_Z)=d$, so that the coefficient is well defined, is [lem-sc-snapper-numerical-polynomial] applied to the coherent module $\mathcal F=i_*\mathcal O_Z$, and it is not part of the definition. When all $\mathcal L_j=\mathcal L$, write $(\mathcal L^d\cdot Z)$.
